description: This file contains functions for integrating with Amazon MWS API, including product retrieval, order processing, and financial data handling within an ERP system.

methods.name: get_products_details
methods.description: Retrieves product data from Amazon and creates or updates items in the ERP system.

methods.name: get_products_instance
methods.description: Initializes and returns an Amazon MWS Products API client.

methods.name: get_reports_instance
methods.description: Initializes and returns an Amazon MWS Reports API client.

methods.name: return_as_list
methods.description: Ensures the input is returned as a list, wrapping it if necessary.

methods.name: chunks
methods.description: Splits a list into chunks of specified size.

methods.name: request_and_fetch_report_id
methods.description: Requests a report from Amazon and polls until the report is generated, returning its ID.

methods.name: call_mws_method
methods.description: Calls an MWS API method with retries and error handling.

methods.name: create_item_code
methods.description: Creates a new Item in ERP based on Amazon product data if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: create_manufacturer
methods.description: Creates a Manufacturer record if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: create_brand
methods.description: Creates a Brand record if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: create_item_price
methods.description: Creates an Item Price record for a given item.

methods.name: get_orders
methods.description: Fetches and processes Amazon orders updated after a specified date.

methods.name: get_orders_instance
methods.description: Initializes and returns an Amazon MWS Orders API client.

methods.name: create_sales_order
methods.description: Creates a Sales Order in ERP from Amazon order data.

methods.name: create_customer
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Customer record based on Amazon order data.

methods.name: create_address
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an Address record for a customer.

methods.name: get_order_items
methods.description: Retrieves items for a specific Amazon order.

methods.name: get_item_code
methods.description: Retrieves the ERP item code for an Amazon order item.

methods.name: get_charges_and_fees
methods.description: Retrieves financial charges and fees for an Amazon order.

methods.name: get_finances_instance
methods.description: Initializes and returns an Amazon MWS Finances API client.

methods.name: get_account
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an ERP Account record for Amazon financial data.
